# Test fixtures: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA ONLY

`forecasts_fixture.parquet` is generated by `make_fixture_forecasts.py`. It has the schema of `results/forecasts.parquet` but
made-up numbers (every point forecast is around Rs 1,000). It is **not derived from the onion dataset** and exists only so that CI can
start the API container and check its healthcheck without the real (git-ignored) data.
